name: Structural proteins overview card
why: Reclassified from AMBIGUOUS after review. The card defines a broad class and then names five examples belonging to four different canonical concepts. No single PRIMARY represents it. An authoring issue, not an ontology gap: it should be rewritten to target one concept or split. Left unmapped rather than forced.
deck: Nonenzymatic Protein Function and Protein Analysis

name: Cytoskeleton three-filament comparison card
why: Compares all three filament classes by diameter and subunit: microfilaments of actin, intermediate filaments, microtubules of tubulin. The ontology deliberately splits the cytoskeleton into five sibling concepts and has no umbrella, so a compare-the-family card has no single PRIMARY. Different flavour from the structural-proteins card: those examples spanned unrelated domains, these are three siblings of one deliberately split family. Surfaces a real observation, that the cytoskeleton family has no umbrella concept. Left unmapped rather than assigned arbitrarily to one of the three.

name: Immune System: 16 proposed concepts (structural gap)
why: THE CHAPTER HAS NO CURRICULUM LAYER. Its 89 concepts are all scenario-derived from the question sweep (Assigning Deficiency Patterns to Immune Arms, Defence Timeline After a Breach, Reading Expansion of a Rare Clone). Searching the whole ontology for immune vocabulary returns exactly two concepts with real question evidence: Immunoglobulins and Respiratory Immune Defense. Only 16 of 76 cards have a defensible home. Forcing the other 60 onto scenario concepts would put wrong evidence on 60 objects. Proposed: Innate versus Adaptive Immunity (1-4); Immune Cell Origins and Lymphoid Organs (5-11); Physical and Chemical Barriers (13,16); Innate Cellular Defenses (17-23); Complement, Cytokines and Interferons (24-26); Natural Killer Cells (27,28); Pattern Recognition and Inflammation (29,30); Antigens and Antigen Presentation (31-36); B Cell Activation and Antibody Diversity (37,42,43); T Cell Subsets and Function (49-54); Thymic Selection and Self-Tolerance (55,56,61); Clonal Selection and Immunologic Memory (57-60); Hypersensitivity and Autoimmunity (62-64); Active and Passive Immunity (65-67); Vaccination (68,69); The Lymphatic System (74-76). Sixteen concepts is a vocabulary extension, not a mapping, so it is your decision rather than mine.
